reviews.comment: Changed the curriculum this semester to make it harder on her students. To compensate for this she made her whole rubric subjective and no matter what you changed based on her feedback you would get the same grade. Very disappointed in the class and professor. She offered no extra credit and no curve to the final grade showing her care for students

Her class is a lot of busy work that takes a long time. Her feedback isn't helpful. No matter how much effort you put into an assignment, you will get the same grade. I ended with an 89.9, and she didn't put in a curve, so I got a B in the class.

Near impossible to earn an A. Hurta is a nice person but a terrible prof. All the content is common sense and you learn nothing new or important. Harsh grader. basically just makes up critiques based on how much she likes you. most frustrating at class of TAMU

Horrible experience. Seriously, avoid this class. It felt like being thrown back into AP English in high school, with a teacher who acts like your grade doesn't matter because they've already decided you're bad at writing. The expectations were completely unrealistic. Taking this teacher made my year way more stressful than it needed to be.

Terrible class. Teacher is nice and all, but quite literally delusional when it comes to grading. If you aren't a professional sales person, don't even bother attempting an A. There's an insane amount of homework for no reason, and it's NOT just completion like it says on the rubric. If you do them too late, you get almost half of the points off???

She only grades on how well of a public speaker you already are and not for growth or improvements you've made throughout the semester. Sorry I can't be annoying, outgoing, and naturally talk in front of 40 students I don't know nor do I wish to know. Wish this class was more realistic rather than so "cut throat".
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor herself is very nice. However, the department made her change the curriculum and grading of the class. With this being said, getting an A is so much harder than it once was. Not that the material is hard, she just grades like you are the secretary for the president. Good luck!

I like Professor Hurta. She is nice. However, I feel like the class is pointless. She has a lot of busy work and unnecessary assignments in her curriculum. She is great- I just don't believe this class is worth my time and energy. Prepare yourself for a lot of busy work.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I heard they changed the course material this year, and it seems much harder to earn an A. The grading feels strict, even for small details, and having part of the grade based on peer review makes it feel less consistent. There's also quite a bit of busy work, and it doesn't always feel like the effort you put in is reflected in the final grade.

Starts her class by saying "effort isn't enough to get an A". Grades very difficultly and takes off points for very small details. Lots of grading done by TA's who also take off points for small details. Make sure to make your recordings basically perfect, otherwise small pauses and a single item in your background can take 20% off your grade.
Professor Hurta is awesome. I've taken two of her classes in the MS - Acc program at TAMU, and while the material is somewhat difficult, she does a great job of explaining it.

One of my favorite professors of all time. 
The class is well structured and the work makes sense.
Be prepared for group work and lots of socializing, but understand that you are there to improve yourself for the future not be the best at the beginning.

Love her!!! You can tell she understands how tedious accounting is sometimes and really lets the student develop soft skills in her class despite the stereotypes about accountants. She gives informative and detailed feedback on speaking assignments. Class consisted of some online work, in-class work, and a group project. Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Hurta is super nice, relatable, and easy to talk to. 489 is a very easy class that involves a couple of presentations, easy grammar quizzes, and essays. The class can be very elementary, but also very helpful. Hurta makes things easy and is a very nice person.

ACCT 489: No book, easy grammar quizzes at the beginning of the semester, writing assignments (Memo, Letter, Email). Group projects and discussions (super easy, nothing to stress about). "Presentation simulation" online and official presentation at end of course - graded on dress code, filler words, tone/volume of voice, hand gestures, etc.

Hurta was an awesome professor. Her class was really easy. There were two presentations that were given during the summer course. The first was individual and the second was a group one. I would definitely recommend this class.

Hurta is an amazing and caring professor. She genuinely wants to see all of her students succeed. If you take the time and pay attention in her class you can leave with valuable information for a future accounting career. Go to class! She will do randomized attendance. Her class is enjoyable and is nothing to be dreaded. Best prof I have had at A&M

Incredible professor who really cares about her students. Class is attendance based and as long as you follow the syllabus and get your stuff done you will do fine. Lectures are interesting and helpful to the real world. Not a hard class.
